title: GEMM host array inputs differ from identical driver list snapshots

evidence.events: campaign-evidence/runs/open_cake-1/events; provider_turn_completed and candidate_rejected; evaluator_request retained by run_fault

observation: The exact fib_gemm_n128_k2048 zeros materializer returns array.array. LoadedTorchTensorCandidate stores lists, so its inputs != self.inputs check refuses equal values. compare_tile_outputs repeats the container equality mistake: zero output_mismatches but inputs_unchanged=false for identical data. Both 004 and 005 retained GPU workers failed with loaded tensor assay input or candidate differs.
proposed_change: Compare tensor values and lengths across admitted host sequence containers, preserving signed-zero bit checks, candidate/manifest identity and input mutation refusal. No Workload, tolerance or kernel change.
principles: Tensor ABI owns values, shapes and precision; Python sequence container type is not a tensor fact.
